idea-plugin.name: Mochi AI Agent
idea-plugin.description:
Mochi AI Agent brings the Mochi coding agent directly into your JetBrains IDE.

Chat with Mochi from a dedicated tool window, send editor selections for explanation or refactoring, switch between plan and act modes, and stream agent responses in real time.

Powered by the Agent Client Protocol (ACP): the plugin spawns mochi acp and communicates over JSON-RPC 2.0 (stdio) — initialize, session/new, session/prompt, session/cancel, shutdown.

Requires the mochi binary on your PATH (configurable in Settings > Tools > Mochi).
idea-plugin.change-notes: 0.1.0: Initial release — Mochi tool window with streaming transcript, Send/Cancel/New session, plan/act mode toggle, Send Selection to Mochi action (Ctrl+Alt+M), and Settings page (binary path, request timeout, notifications).

action.description: Send the current editor selection to the Mochi agent
